title: Value Bands Applied to a Withheld Share on Car Hire
content:
Where a hire booked under the Car Rental Rate Classes is given up, the value of the rental itself may raise
the share already settled. The value is read from the money settled in advance worked out for each charged rental day of the
booking.

Where the money settled in advance works out at more than 90 USD for each charged rental day, the multiple
is 1.1. Where it works out at more than 60 USD for each charged rental day, the multiple is 1.05. Where it
works out at 60 USD or less for each charged rental day, no multiple under this head is applied to it.

| Money settled in advance, for each charged rental day | Multiple |
| --- | --- |
| more than 90 USD | 1.1 |
| more than 60 USD but not more than 90 USD | 1.05 |

## A figure standing on a boundary

The bands turn on *more than*, so a figure standing exactly on a boundary falls to the band below it.

- 90.01 USD for each charged rental day is more than 90 USD: the multiple is 1.1.
- 90 USD exactly is not more than 90 USD, but is more than 60 USD: the multiple is 1.05.
- 60 USD exactly is not more than 60 USD: no multiple under this head applies.

## Two rentals compared

A hypothetical rental of 5 charged rental days carrying 480 USD of money settled in advance works out at
96 USD for each charged rental day, which is more than 90 USD, so the multiple is 1.1. The same 480 USD
across 7 charged rental days works out at about 68.57 USD for each day, which is more than 60 USD but not
more than 90 USD, so the multiple is 1.05.
